content.value: A settling tank has an internal area of 125 m². The particles in the tank have a (17) diameter of $1 0 ^ { - 5 } \mathsf { m } , \mathsf { R e } = 0 . 4$ , and specific gravity = 2.60. The water temperature in the tank is 298K and the sedimentation period is 218 min. The sludge accumulation zone is 0.5 m and the total depth (including sludge accumulation zone) is 2.1 m. Determine the tank efficiency. If the tank efficiency is less than 90%, redesign the tank to maintain an efficiency of 90%.
